scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Elitr out/elitr-demo-1080p-direct.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 14 --x264-preset slow --image-format png --pixel-format yuv420p --audio-codec aac --audio-bitrate 320k
scripts.poster: remotion still src/index.ts Poster out/elitr-thumbnail.png && remotion still src/index.ts Poster out/elitr-thumbnail-4k.png --scale 2
scripts.render4k: remotion render src/index.ts Elitr out/elitr-demo-4k-raw.mp4 --scale 2 --image-format png --codec h264 --crf 12 --x264-preset veryslow --pixel-format yuv420p --audio-codec aac --audio-bitrate 320k --concurrency 8
scripts.1080p: ffmpeg -y -i out/elitr-demo-4k.mp4 -vf scale=1920:1080:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -crf 14 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy -movflags +faststart out/elitr-demo-1080p.mp4
